title: A miner already within a jump of Hex Star (Dheneb) gives the iron and copper it stored there to the trader Trade named there (strict classes)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-25T11:52Z (orders ENT-093 block ZERO: read the iron stored at Bursar hubs; give it where a receiver stands). The storage book of 11:35 UTC: 24 miners hold 22178 iron and 12265 copper in their own storage at Hex Star (Dheneb), stored there by mine-network before allow_bursar_dropoffs went false (3ef7d3cb). Iron and copper bid 0 to 1 cr at these hubs (market books 11:40 UTC), so no ship flies far for it: requires.max_jumps 1 sends only a miner already in or next to the system. A trader receiver stands named here (handover.py receivers, Mercury's). requires.stored opens on either good, 50 or more.
